title: Godspell Vintage High School Theater Program Newman Smith Carrollton Texas Schwartz
condition_description: Complete program. Red cover with light handling wear and minor corner wear; pages clean. See photos.
description:
Vintage Godspell theater program from Newman Smith High School (Carrollton, Texas). Red cover with the classic Godspell artwork.

Godspell - a musical based upon the Gospel according to St. Matthew. Music and new lyrics by Stephen Schwartz, conceived by John-Michael Tebelak. Directed by Mildred A. Peveto; arrangement by Theatre Maximus, Inc.

Inside: director's notes, stage ensemble cast list, Act I and Act II musical synopsis (Prepare Ye, Day by Day, Learn Your Lessons Well, Turn Back O Man, By My Side and more), production staff and student production staff.

No performance date is printed on the pages shown. See photos for condition. Ships flat in a protective mailer.
